gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: During 2015 the syndicate increased its estimated ultimate loss ratios on certain prior years (notably 2014 and 2013 and prior), driven principally by adverse development in the US liability portfolio. This resulted in a net strengthening of prior year gross claims reserves of approximately GBP 35.8m (c.11.1% of opening gross reserves), concentrated in Accident & Health, Liability (Casualty) and Special Lines (Professional Lines). The Managing Agent attributes the movements to worse-than-expected claims experience, litigation-related exposures in the US liability account and an upward recalibration of IBNR.
